name: deep-isq
description: ICQ-подобный чат («Аська»): Node.js + TypeScript + Redux SPA, архитектура MVP

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @isq/server && npm run build -w @isq/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @isq/server" "npm run dev -w @isq/client"
scripts.start: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @isq/server
